_comment: Each guide gets a page at /guides/<slug> and a sitemap entry. The body lives in app/views/guides/<slug>.php. related: a product or service path to promote at the end.

guides.title: ERP software in Pakistan: a buyer's checklist for small and mid-sized businesses
guides.description: What to check before choosing ERP software in Pakistan: sales and withholding tax, PKR banking, multiple companies, user access, data migration from Excel or QuickBooks, and cost.

guides.title: Moving from QuickBooks to an ERP without losing your history
guides.description: A step-by-step guide to exporting the QuickBooks Journal report, matching accounts, checking totals and switching to an ERP with your full transaction history.

guides.title: Installment and recovery tracking for real estate developers
guides.description: How housing projects and developers can replace installment spreadsheets with a recovery system: receipts against dues, overdue aging, bank collections and a recovery desk.

guides.title: How to turn an Excel stock register into inventory software
guides.description: A step-by-step plan for moving your stock spreadsheet into real inventory software without losing data or stopping sales.

guides.title: 7 signs your business has outgrown spreadsheets
guides.description: Spreadsheets are a great start. Here are the seven warning signs that yours are now costing you time, money and sleep, and what to do next.

guides.title: 5 Google Apps Script automations for small business bookkeeping
guides.description: Five practical Google Sheets automations that save bookkeepers hours each week, from invoice numbering to month-end reminders.
